shared_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production in-game sprite atlas with genuine transparent alpha background. Crisp hand-inked COMIC BOOK cel illustration, broad readable shapes, clean anti-aliased edges, detailed costume, NOT pixel art, no dithering. EXACTLY EIGHT COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS with equal square cells, landscape 2:1 canvas, around 3072x1536. One complete full body per cell, SAME character, same costume, same scale and lighting. Row 1 SOUTH/front, row 2 EAST/right profile, row 3 NORTH/back, row 4 WEST/left profile. Steep three-quarter TOP-DOWN camera matches top-down action game in every tile. Feet on 90% cell baseline, character occupies 72% cell height with clear gutters; every limb stays in its tile. Columns: 1 neutral ready stance; 2 walk/run left leg forward; 3 walk/run right leg forward; 4 attack windup; 5 full attack extension or power cast; 6 defensive braced stance; 7 hurt recoil; 8 low advancing dash/lunge. Keep all tiles separated with generous transparent margins. No text, grid lines, labels, floor, scenery, shadow blobs, or glow clouds. Reference image defines identity, palette, anatomy and costume; preserve those, draw full body. Original game character.

characters.description: A tall athletic Black woman hero with close-cropped silver hair, high white collar, ivory-and-gold fitted superhero suit, restrained radiant gold halo ring. Calm commanding presence.
A broad muscular older man military hero, short grey hair, stern weathered face, heavy olive-grey tactical armour, huge reinforced gauntlets, dull steel-blue accents.

An androgynous young adult psychic hero, slim athletic build, black asymmetrical undercut with violet streak, luminous violet circular ear comm, dark fitted suit with high white collar and purple lining.
A tall lean adult man former villain, shoulder-length brown hair, short beard, layered dark-green organic armour, restrained ivy growing over one shoulder, leaf-green luminous details.
An athletic adult woman engineer with medium brown skin, black curly hair tied back, amber goggles on head, large grey teal headset, blue-grey utility coveralls, orange harness, tool belt.

A powerful stocky middle-aged woman foundry villain, dark hair tied up, orange glowing safety visor, heavy dark industrial furnace armour, shoulder vents and massive mechanical forearm gauntlets glowing molten orange.
A tall Black woman sonic diva villain with close-cropped hair, gold earrings, black and gold stage armour with large speaker modules on shoulders, confident commanding posture.
An eerie androgynous plant-and-corroded-copper armoured villain, full angular pointed copper mask with slit acid-green eyes, layered ragged leaf cloak, tendrils, controlled acid-green details.

An athletic woman mirror villain, swept asymmetrical white hair with pink ends, black angular full eye visor with magenta slits, black geometric bodysuit with polished glass shards and vivid magenta trim.
A broad muscular middle-aged male dockworker villain, wet messy black hair, rugged angry face, enormous deep-sea industrial pressure suit and cyan circular valves, ice gauntlets.
A huge ancient humanoid stone golem, angular charcoal rock plates, broad massive shoulders with floating stone arcs, narrow vertical purple face slit, restrained purple fissures. Heavy stone anatomy.

A tall slender male main villain in tailored black angular long coat with crimson lining, bone-white faceless rectangular mask with one thin vertical red slit, elegant gloved hands, floating black rectangular shield slabs behind shoulders. Human quiet menace.
A lean threatening hooded street fighter in dark charcoal fitted armour, red-orange angular hood, faceless dark mask and coral-orange sleeve details, carries a short metal pipe. Generic mob enemy.
A compact hovering hostile drone, angular black and dark-brass wing panels, central glowing amber optic, twin slim needle cannons. No human body, no legs. Mechanical silhouette.

volt_prompt: Volt: original young adult male electric hero; black/silver crest, blue visor, black electric-blue and white suit. Eight columns by four directions; idle, two runs, windup, strike, block, hurt, dash. See shared prompt for technical specification.
